## About

Software Engineer II at Salesforce, Bengaluru, building backend systems for Tableau Licensing Services. Work spans licensing infrastructure, user services, and cloud migrations, with a focus on reliability and scale. Drawn to hard problems: distributed systems, AI infrastructure, and the kind of engineering which leaves an impact. Builds side projects and writes about things encountered along the way.

## Experience

### Salesforce (July 2024 – Present)
- Software Engineer II (Feb 2026 – Present)
- Software Engineer I (July 2024 – Jan 2026)
Started with Tableau Cloud Manager's User Service, building user lifecycle APIs, saga-based sync to Tableau Pods, bulk operations via Step Functions, and license consumption tracking on multi-region DynamoDB. Then moved to Tableau's Licensing team, working across different licensing services to ship activation, lease management, and freemium licensing.

### Porter — Software Development Intern (Jan 2024 – Jun 2024)
Part of the Customer Growth & Engagement team. Built backend services powering cashback, referrals, and transactional flows that scaled to production traffic. Ktor, Dagger, clean APIs, and zero P0s across the internship.

### Salesforce — Software Development Intern (Jan 2024 – Jun 2024)
Built a config drift detection pipeline for Tableau Cloud pods, pulling configs from GitLab repos and S3, diffing against the golden baseline, auto-filing GUS defects, and alerting teams on Slack. Fully automated, zero manual toil.

### Samsung — Software Development Intern (May 2022 – Jul 2022)
Automated a full regression suite using Selenium and Pytest, replacing hours of manual QA effort per cycle. Cut regression turnaround significantly and freed the team to focus on shipping instead of re-testing.

## Projects

- [Real-Time Collaborative Editor](https://github.com/hgpt185/google-docs-clone) — Google Docs-style editor with real-time multi-user collaboration using Socket.io and operational transforms. TypeScript, React, MongoDB.
- [ERPLAG Compiler](https://github.com/hgpt185/ERPLANG-Compiler) — Complete compiler for ERPLAG in C: lexer, parser, semantic analyzer, and code generator. Written from scratch with no libraries.
- [chotu: URL Shortener](https://github.com/hgpt185/chotu) — URL shortener service built with Spring Boot. Clean REST API and redirect tracking. Java, Spring Boot.
- [ASCII Image Converter](https://github.com/hgpt185/AsciiImage) — Converts any image into ASCII art. CLI tool and Django REST API, deployed with WSGI. Python, Django.
- [Spring Boot E-Commerce API](https://github.com/hgpt185/spring-boot-ecom-proj) — RESTful product catalog and shopping cart API with CRUD, image uploads, and keyword search. Java, Spring Boot.
- [Packet Sniffer](https://github.com/hgpt185/Packet-Sniffer) — Java network tool for capturing and inspecting live traffic, with port scanning and basic traffic analysis.
- [Personal Website](https://github.com/hgpt185/hemesh-gupta-software-engineer) — Original portfolio built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
